text: I am longer than I am broad, and seem taller than I really am; I am never at rest, and am never quiet; I am increased by length, and diminished by height; I am larger in summer, and smaller in winter; I am assisted by figures, and I am made to look longer than I am; I am increased by figures, and am still more increased by figures, and am greatest in the summer, and least in the summer.

judge.name: Changing-length riddle
judge.description: The reply gives a first-person riddle about changing length and size without revealing the speaker’s identity.

ranking.reason: Describes changing dimensions and seasonal variation in a riddle-like passage.
